mega_book.note: No mega-book in the kernel. Books stay independent. This app cites per-book /budget and /billing figures and rolls those cites up. It does not merge journals, invent a fifth BookKind, or put a program URL on screensFor. An org_id claim is not membership — ListBooks is filtered to PROJECT books the subject can see (books:read).

eac_forecast.note: No EAC, cost-to-complete, or cash forecast. Those stay on #169. /budget still does not forecast. Remaining to spend is revised − incurred − awarded when a book can support the cut; a program remaining is the sum of those per-book remaining cites, never a silent 0.00 for a book that cannot.

aia_g702.note: No AIA G702/G703 product UI. That door is #184. This app cites billed / remaining-to-bill / collections; it does not pack a pay-app or render a licensed form.

vendor_portal.note: No vendor user directory and no vendor / GC portal. That door is #172.

grant_path.note: In-process /v1 accepts Connect catalog scopes after membership. API Gateway JWT verifies Connect tokens on ConnectApiUrl. leftover #22: live provider OAuth, RATIO_DEMO_OPEN, unused Cognito. Write-route actor binding landed (#151). This file leaves #150 and #179 open. It does not reopen #151. It leaves #169, #172, and #184 open.
